Fry green plantain chunks at 160C until soft, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Salt and spoon over garlic, lime and olive oil mojo.
M: slow roast pork shoulder with crackling, rice and pigeon peas
Stab pork shoulder all over, rub with garlic, oregano, adobo and vinegar, marinate overnight. Roast at 160C for 5 hours skin up, then 230C to crackle. Arroz con gandules alongside.
mashed plantain, pork crackling and garlic
Fry green plantain chunks, mash in a mortar with garlic, olive oil and crushed pork crackling. Pack into a bowl and turn out. Prawns sautéed in garlic butter with stock poured around.
W: caramel and coconut, for the beach poster Carlito stares at
Caramelise 150g sugar into a ring tin. Blend condensed milk, coconut milk, evaporated milk and 5 eggs, pour over, bake in a water bath at 160C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight and turn out.
K: El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch
rum, fruit juice, lime and cinnamon syrup over ice, nutmeg, before the train to Miami

Dark rum shaken with pineapple, fresh lime and a little spiced syrup, served long over ice with grated nutmeg. Make spiced syrup by simmering 50g brown sugar, 50ml water and 1 cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, stir together 180ml dark rum, 360ml pineapple juice, 60ml lime juice, 40ml spiced syrup and 4 dashes aromatic bitters. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and pour the punch over. Grate a little nutmeg on top and garnish with a lime wheel.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the cod 1 day ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Soak the salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing the water three times, then drain and flake.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, water, garlic and coriander into a loose batter and fold in the cod.
Fry wide flat spoonfuls in 180C oil in batches until golden and lacy.
Drain and salt.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled; fry just before serving

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and flake them with a fork into rough shreds.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, water, garlic, coriander and nori into a loose batter and fold in the hearts of palm.
Fry wide flat spoonfuls in 180C oil in batches until golden and lacy.
Drain and finish with flaky salt.

dishes.make_ahead: Fry once up to 2 hours ahead; second fry just before serving

steps.text: Peel the plantains and cut into 3cm chunks.
Fry at 160C for 4 minutes until soft.
Smash flat with a heavy glass and fry again at 190C until crisp. Salt well.
Mix the garlic, lime juice and olive oil and spoon over.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate overnight; cooked pork reheats well

steps.text: Stab the pork all over and rub with garlic, oregano, salt and vinegar. Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Roast skin up at 160C for 5 hours.
Raise the oven to 230C for 20 minutes to crackle the skin.
Cook the rice with the drained pigeon peas, stock and onion until tender, and serve alongside the sliced pork.

ingredients.item: oyster and king oyster mushrooms, torn into large pieces

steps.text: Mix the garlic, oregano, salt, vinegar and oil, toss through the mushrooms and leave to marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 230C and spread the mushrooms over two lined trays.
Roast the mushrooms, turning once, until the edges are dark and crisp.
Meanwhile cook the rice with the drained pigeon peas, stock and onion until tender, and serve with the mushrooms piled on top.
Melt the sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a ring tin.
Blend the condensed milk, coconut milk, evaporated milk and eggs and pour over the caramel.
Bake in a water bath at 160C for 50 minutes until just set.
Chill overnight, run a knife around the edge and turn out onto a plate.

dishes.n: El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and cinnamon for 3 minutes, then cool.
In a jug, stir the rum, pineapple juice, lime juice, 40ml of the syrup and bitters.
Pour over ice into four tall glasses, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a lime wheel.
Simmer the sugar, water and cinnamon for 3 minutes, then cool.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill.
In a jug, stir 180ml of the tea, the pineapple juice, lime juice, 40ml of the syrup and the vanilla.
Pour over ice into four tall glasses, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a lime wheel.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the onion and soak it in lime up to 2 hours ahead; cut the avocado just before serving

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of one lime with a pinch of the salt so it softens and turns pink.
Tear the lettuce onto a platter. Cut the avocados and tomatoes into thick wedges and lay them over.
Scatter the onion over with its lime, squeeze over the second lime, drizzle the oil and season with the rest of the salt.
Finish with torn coriander and serve straight away.

edition.cue: Have dessert out before Benny Blanco finds Carlito at Grand Central.

s.how: Soak 250g salt cod for 24 hours, changing the water three times, then flake. Whisk 200g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 300ml water, 2 crushed garlic cloves and a handful of chopped coriander into a loose batter and fold in the cod. Fry wide flat spoonfuls in 180C oil until golden and lacy, drain and salt.

Peel 3 green plantains and cut into 3cm chunks. Fry at 160C for 4 minutes until soft, smash flat with a heavy glass and fry again at 190C until crisp. Salt well. Mix 3 crushed garlic cloves with the juice of 2 limes and 60ml olive oil and spoon over.

m.note: slow roast pork shoulder with crackling, rice and pigeon peas
m.how: Stab a 2kg pork shoulder all over and rub with 8 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, 2 tsp salt and 2 tbsp white vinegar. Marinate overnight. Roast skin up at 160C for 5 hours, then 230C for 20 minutes to crackle. Cook 400g long grain rice with a 400g tin of pigeon peas, stock and a little onion to serve alongside.

w.note: caramel and coconut, for the beach poster Carlito stares at
w.how: Melt 150g caster sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a ring tin. Blend a 395g tin condensed milk, 270ml coconut milk, 375ml evaporated milk and 5 eggs and pour over the caramel. Bake in a water bath at 160C for 50 minutes until just set. Chill overnight, run a knife around and turn out onto a plate.
